description: Operate dbt Cloud jobs and runs from one static Go binary — trigger, watch to completion with honest exit codes, and query run history offline.

novel_features.name: Monitor run to completion
novel_features.description: Watch a dbt Cloud run until it finishes, with live status and an exit code that reflects success or failure.

novel_features.name: Trigger and wait
novel_features.description: Trigger a job and watch the resulting run to completion in one command, returning the run's exit status.

novel_features.name: Run-history stats
novel_features.description: Success rate, average and p95 duration, and failure counts per job over a time window from the local run mirror.

novel_features.name: Recent failures
novel_features.description: Recently failed runs in a time window, grouped by job, with each run's failed-step names.

novel_features.name: Artifact diff
novel_features.description: Diff run_results.json between two runs to show which models newly failed or changed timing.
